column24: BrainTrust Bio (BTB) has reimagined the ways in which we can make an existing therapy more effective. Through the transformative power of our science, we are currently developing multiple new therapies including a life-altering treatment for patients living with ALS. We are improving on already-proven therapeutics.
column25: BraintTrust Bio’s (BTB) lead indication is in the field of ALS, currently, the only drug that has shown any success in increasing the survival of patients with ALS is Riluzole. This drug is currently administered orally, which limits its efficacy, BTB’s treatment protocol using Intrathecal administration increases the efficacy by 3 to 4 times while also reducing adverse events. BTB has been treating two patients (off-label) for four years, both are tolerating the treatment with no significant side effects. BTB’s new treatment not only prolongs a patient’s survival, but significantly improves upon their quality of life.
